text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein says the United States is the "worst dictator" in history.
- Saddam receives former Algerian President Ahmed Ben Bella.
- Warnings against Americans in Saudi Arabia.
- Iraq protests against violations of its airspace by allied warplanes.
- (The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- UAE takes measures to boost trade with Iraq.
- U.S. Secretary of State Albright fails to gain European acceptance of plans on NATO.
- Editorial says U.S. is the main source of threat in region and not Iraq or Iran.
- Commentary says Turkey caught up between Islamist and secular trends.
